about: One caption per timeline segment (the names of timeline.py and timeline_retimed.py). English only: the Armenian section names come from sections.json, already authored. Grades follow the deck: Measured, Established, Estimate, Conjecture; 'authored' marks numbers that come from hand-made features, not from data.
flight: The 36 letters leave the painted stone; each one rings it as it leaves (its Chladni sand figure).
line: They settle on the gilt line.
lift: They lift into a turning helix inside the astronomer's armillary globe: ecliptic, equator, the precession circle, three planets.
tour: The tour of the 36: each letter's card, three attention heads (authored: sound, number, order), the 36 × 36 map, its Chladni figure, mode (column + 1, row + 1).
write: Writing 405: the first sentence translated, Proverbs 1:2, written glyph by glyph, inked in flight, with causal attention arcs.
prayer: The Lord's Prayer in Classical Armenian, written the same way (one line left out: its Օ entered the alphabet in the Middle Ages).
numerals: Letters are numbers: the 4 × 9 matrix; 405, 1512, 2026 and 1475 light their letters.
shirakatsi: Shirakatsi's table, recomputed in his own numerals.
space: The embedding space: the letters on two articulatory axes (authored), the 3 × 36 × 36 attention tensor turning beside them.
web: The alphabet as a graph: 630 chords, each weighted by attention (authored heads).
msg: Message passing from Ճ: h⁽ˡ⁺¹⁾ = Â h⁽ˡ⁾, six layers.
spectral: The Fiedler cut: the second eigenvector of L = D − W splits the ring (λ₂ = 0.488, of the authored graph).
vowels: Measured: in 342,533 letters of Grabar, the graph's fastest mode lifts the vowels. 35 of 36 agree with the deck; Ւ alone is the consonant w.
spectral2: The Fiedler cut: the second eigenvector of L = D − W splits the ring (λ₂ = 0.488, of the authored graph).
pagerank: PageRank, d = 0.85: rank flows along the chords for fifteen iterations.
anneal: Annealing: the softmax temperature τ sweeps from 0.12 to 3 and back; the graph melts and freezes.
descent: Gradient descent with momentum: 48 steps into a quadratic bowl.
walk: A Markov chain on the attention graph: 36 walkers; their occupancy approaches the stationary distribution.
fourier: Fourier epicycles redraw the PageRank shape of the alphabet, harmonics added as it turns (19 terms).
poincare: The Poincaré disk: the chords become hyperbolic geodesics, orthogonal to the boundary.
svd: SVD of the attention matrix: rank 1 to 6 and their residuals; the letters on two singular vectors, where k-means finds four families.
collapse: The graph folds back into the line.
finale: Pre-training in Armenian, 20 bars at 128 BPM: the token bill (Measured), one word in many shapes (Measured), the data-scaling law (published fit; its three points are placeholders), the Armenian-only floor (Established inside 70 M to 1 B parameters, an Estimate beyond). The closing line is a Conjecture.
line2: The letters return to the line.
return: They fall home into the stone.
rest: The colophon: written in the Armenian year 1475, which is 2026.
